templates:
#!/bin/sh
basedir=$(dirname "$(echo "$0" | sed -e 's,\\,/,g')")

case `uname` in
    *CYGWIN*|*MINGW*|*MSYS*)
        if command -v cygpath > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            basedir=`cygpath -w "$basedir"`
        fi
    ;;
esac

if [ -x "$basedir/node" ]; then
  exec "$basedir/node"  "$basedir/{{TARGET}}" "$@"
else 
  exec node  "$basedir/{{TARGET}}" "$@"
fi
templates..cmd:
@ECHO off
GOTO start
:find_dp0
SET dp0=%~dp0
EXIT /b
:start
SETLOCAL
CALL :find_dp0

IF EXIST "%dp0%\node.exe" (
  SET "_prog=%dp0%\node.exe"
) ELSE (
  SET "_prog=node"
  SET PATHEXT=%PATHEXT:;.JS;=;%
)

endLocal & goto #_undefined_# 2>NUL || title %COMSPEC% & "%_prog%"  "%dp0%\{{TARGET}}" %*

templates:
#!/bin/sh
basedir=$(dirname "$(echo "$0" | sed -e 's,\\,/,g')")
basedir_win="$basedir"

case `uname -a` in
  *CYGWIN*|*MINGW*|*MSYS*)
    if command -v cygpath > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      basedir_win=`cygpath -w "$basedir"`
    fi
  ;;
  *WSL2*)
    if command -v wslpath > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      basedir_win="$(wslpath -w "$basedir" 2> /dev/null)"
      if [ $? -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$basedir_win" ]; then
        echo "Error: wslpath failed to convert path. WSL environment may be misconfigured." >&2
        exit 1
      fi
    fi
  ;;
esac

PROG_EXE="$basedir/node.exe"
if ! [ -x "$PROG_EXE" ]; then
  PROG_EXE="$basedir/node"
  if ! [ -x "$PROG_EXE" ]; then
    PROG_EXE=node
    if ! [ -x "$PROG_EXE" ]; then
      PROG_EXE=node.exe
    fi
  fi
fi

exec "$PROG_EXE"  "$basedir_win/{{TARGET}}" "$@"
templates..cmd:
@ECHO off
GOTO start
:find_dp0
SET dp0=%~dp0
EXIT /b
:start
SETLOCAL
CALL :find_dp0

IF EXIST "%dp0%\node.exe" (
  SET "_prog=%dp0%\node.exe"
) ELSE (
  SET "_prog=node"
)

endLocal & goto #_undefined_# 2>NUL || title %COMSPEC% & set PATHEXT=%PATHEXT:;.JS;=;% & "%_prog%"  "%dp0%\{{TARGET}}" %*
